item.title: 2026 Southern Indoor Championships Podiums
item.description: Check out the podiums from the 2026 Racetime Entertainment Southern Indoor Championships held this past weekend in Gainesville, Georgia.

item.title: New Donathen RC Heated Battery Sleeve V4
item.description: Donathen RC has released the 4th version of their heated battery sleeve which includes a temperature probe and 3 new optimized temperature options.

item.title: New VP-Pro Poison Needle 1/8th Buggy Tread Pattern
item.description: Following release the Hyperdrive Evo, VP-Pro is thrilled to introduce another new tire for 1/8 scale Buggy, the VP-818 Poison Needle Evo.

item.title: New Tekno RC Polished 1/8th Scale Shock Caps
item.description: Building on Tekno RC's proven shock cap design, this polished shock cap set delivers the same versatility and strength racers trust—now with a race-inspired polished finish.

item.title: Drake Talks Tuning With Wheelbase [VIDEO]
item.description: This week Adam Drake talks about tuning with wheelbase and the pros and cons of the different options.

item.title: New Factory Team T7 and SC7 Chassis Protectors
item.description: Factory Team proudly introduces chassis protectors for the RC10T7 and RC10SC7.

item.title: New Team Xray X4'26 2mm Upper Deck
item.description: This Team Xray X4'26 2mm one-piece top deck features milled holes for special tweak-free top deck screws and works with the center layshaft location in the middle of the chassis.

item.title: Adrenaline Racing AR2026 Servo [VIDEO]
item.description: Take control of every corner with the Adrenaline RC Racing AR2026 Steering Servo — built for racers who demand speed, strength, and precision.

item.title: Top25rc Rankings Following The 2026 TNR Fuels Challenge
item.description: The TNR Fuels Challenge finished up this past weekend and had enough star power to update the Top25rc Rankings list. Check out the updated list and who has joined the top 25 ranks.

item.title: New Team Associated YZ-10 Classic Edition
item.description: When the serious racers on Team Associated wanted to go 4WD racing, they chose the best car they could find: The Yokomo YZ-10.
